triage.desk_query: Term sheet G07 states: "Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%." The booking record field autocall_level_pct is set to ['100', '100', '100'], i.e. a flat 100% trigger at all three observation dates, whereas the term sheet specifies a stepping-down schedule of 100% / 95% / 90%. Please confirm the intended autocall schedule and, if the stepped levels are correct, rebook autocall_level_pct as [100, 95, 90] aligned to 20 Jan 2027, 20 Jan 2028 and 20 Jul 2028. If the flat 100% booking is intentional, identify the amendment or supplement that overrides the term sheet.
triage.cited_clause: Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous, explicitly stepping schedule in the term sheet, so the flat 100% booking most likely reflects a capture error that dropped the step-down.
